def main():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    
    n = int(data[0])
    m = int(data[1])
    x = list(map(int, data[2:2 + m]))
    
    if m == 1:
        print(0)
        return
    
    total_length = 0
    for i in range(m - 1):
        total_length += abs(x[i + 1] - x[i])
    
    min_length = total_length
    
    for i in range(1, m - 1):
        closed_length = total_length - abs(x[i] - x[i - 1]) - abs(x[i + 1] - x[i]) + abs(x[i + 1] - x[i - 1])
        min_length = min(min_length, closed_length)
    
    print(min_length)
